visualAuthority.primary: Approved Home and World reference boards
visualAuthority.instruction: Before redesigning any page, re-open Home and World, read the real route and function checklist, state the page's single user job, preserve all real functions, and compare the result side-by-side with Home and World before calling it finished.

display.purpose: Page identity, journeys, destinations, emotional moments, and major hierarchy.

body.purpose: Travel data, controls, forms, metadata, and dense functional information.

surfaceJobs.world: Where have I been / where might I go?
surfaceJobs.trips: Which journey am I working on?
surfaceJobs.recs: What places did I save / what should I do with them?
surfaceJobs.you: Who am I to Béa / how does Béa work for me?
surfaceJobs.trip-companion: Current stop → leave by → next stop → later.
surfaceJobs.trip-map: Spatial understanding; map owns the viewport.
surfaceJobs.trip-timeline: View and edit the ordered itinerary.
surfaceJobs.trip-bookings: What is actually booked and attached.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Use Béa ink for the strongest high-confidence forward action, or periwinkle-cobalt for selected/planning/map interaction. Pink is never the default primary action color.

components.name: Ink Primary Action
components.description: The strongest structural CTA when black creates better hierarchy than a chromatic action.

components.name: Floating Surface
components.description: White or translucent supporting surface over geography, photography, globe, or terrain. Sparse controls only; not a default wrapper for all content.

components.name: Selected Control
components.description: Selected state combines geometry/weight with periwinkle-soft or a meaningful supporting pastel; never relies on color alone.

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Exactly five member destinations: Home, World, Trips, Recs, You. Active state uses geometry, icon weight and restrained accent; no route-specific brand color ownership.

narrative.overview: Béa is immersive geography + editorial typography + sparse utility UI. The approved Home and World references are the visual authority. Travel content creates the drama; controls support it. Non-geographic utilities inherit the same typography, palette, spacing and polish without forcing maps or terrain.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant visual or functional object per important screen.
Instrument Serif for editorial identity and Manrope for functional UI.
Colorful uses one consistent app ground, Béa ink as the brand anchor, periwinkle-cobalt as the primary chromatic interaction accent, and five peer supporting pastels.
Pink is a supporting pastel, not the defining UI accent.
Travel imagery, globe, routes, maps and memories provide visual richness where geography matters.
Cards support the hierarchy; they are not the default layout primitive.
The real repository defines functionality; redesigns do not silently remove or invent product behavior.

rules.name: Approved References First
rules.body: Home and World references are the visual authority. Read the real route before redesigning any other page.

rules.name: Ink Anchors the Brand
rules.body: Béa should remain recognizable without pastel color. Large editorial type and core structure use near-black ink.

rules.name: Periwinkle Is Interaction, Not Wallpaper
rules.body: #6675FF is the primary chromatic interaction accent, used sparingly for focus, selection, route emphasis and important interactive states.

rules.name: Pastels Are Peers
rules.body: Blush, powder blue, mint, butter and lavender support hierarchy. No pastel owns a top-level tab or whole page.

rules.name: No Terracotta
rules.body: Terracotta and burnt-orange UI chrome are outside the approved system.

rules.name: One Ground
rules.body: Colorful uses #FBF8F4 consistently as the app ground rather than generating multiple unrelated whites, creams or beiges.

rules.name: Geography When It Matters
rules.body: Use immersive geography on travel/spatial surfaces; do not force it onto auth, settings, documents, expenses or legal screens.

rules.name: No Card Soup
rules.body: Prefer one dominant object, floating controls, compact strips, spacing, hairlines, and progressive disclosure over grids of equal cards.

rules.name: Behavior Is Sacred
rules.body: Visual redesigns preserve existing product functions unless the owner explicitly approves a behavioral change.

dos: Re-open approved Home and World before every page redesign.
Read the actual route and relevant function checklist before designing.
Use #FBF8F4 as the Colorful app ground and #0A0A0A as the brand anchor.
Use #6675FF sparingly as the main chromatic interaction accent.
Keep blush, sky, mint, butter and lavender as peer supporting pastels.
Use real travel content to create visual interest.
Keep Home, World, Trips, Recs, You as the exact member navigation labels.
Compare new work side-by-side with Home and World before calling it finished.
donts: Do not make pink the defining UI accent.
Do not assign a different brand accent to each top-level tab.
Do not introduce terracotta or burnt-orange UI chrome.
Do not generate different whites/creams for different Colorful pages.
Do not wrap every piece of information in a card.
Do not replace the World globe with a flat map on the Map tab.
Do not add decorative clouds to the approved World globe.
Do not invent mascots or unapproved Béa artwork.
Do not remove or invent product behavior for visual neatness.
